title_how: Buy a second pillar: a ready multi-tenant platform

flow.detail: Rank platforms by multi-tenant revenue, contract length, churn, carrier overlap and fit with SBA markets
Underwrite run-rate EBITDA plus organic growth; cap the multiple; fund with a mix that protects rating
Retain platform management and sales team; ring-fence growth capex; avoid forced integration in year one
Bundle towers + platform for carriers, add sites via SBA land and build skills, tuck in smaller bolt-ons

payers.pays_for: Colocation and cross-connects with network effects; CoreSite proved it inside a tower REIT
Cloud and AI demand in Brazil, where SBA already operates; ODATA/Scala show buyer appetite
Carriers share coverage in venues, transit, campuses; long contracts, tower-like tenancy
Fiber to towers and edge sites; cuts carrier cost, but needs dense markets for good yields

title_plan: Learn from AMT, Crown Castle and LatAm deals

precedents.name: American Tower + CoreSite (2021)
precedents.what: US$ 10.1B for an interconnection data center REIT; kept CoreSite brand and team; data center growth ~13-14% in 2025

precedents.name: Crown Castle + Lightower (2017)
precedents.what: US$ 7.1B for ~32k fiber route miles to feed small cells; returns lagged and fiber/small cells were sold in 2025 for US$ 8.5B

precedents.name: Aligned + ODATA (2022-23)
precedents.what: Macquarie-backed Aligned bought ODATA (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile), reportedly ~US$ 1.8B, to enter LatAm at scale

plan.milestones: Pick 1-2 platform types, build target list in US/Brazil, set price and leverage guardrails, line up partner capital
Sign and close one platform (or JV stake with option to control); keep management; launch 100-day plan
Cross-sell to carriers and cloud clients, fund bolt-ons and expansions, report the segment separately

kpis: Yield on invested capital vs. WACC by year 3-5
Tenants per asset / cross-connects and churn
Net leverage and AFFO per share accretion
